audio_caption: The clip begins with mellow, acoustic guitar music that sets a calm mood. A female speaker then takes over in a warm and welcoming tone, greeting listeners to the LMT YouTube channel. Shifting the subject, the speaker announces a discussion of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's celebration for Archie's first birthday, mentioning how the world rejoiced and touching on their privacy, ending on the note that here is what we know so far. The guitar music then fades back in.

The clip starts with a female speaker announcing that Archie's birthday will be celebrated in Scotland with Queen Elizabeth, mentioning Prince Harry and Megan's plans to visit Balmoral Castle. The tone is informative and somewhat formal. The speaker shares that the Sussexes plan a picnic with the Queen on the estate grounds and suggests that the Queen hasn't seen Archie since last summer. She also mentions that Archie loves being outside, and he is excited by seeing all the trees. The speaker transitions to remarking that Archie is into everything now that he is just walking and mentions he'll often end up covered in mud.

The audio clip begins with light, gentle music playing in the background. A female speaker with a neutral tone announces Archie will have a second celebration in North America for friends and family, adding that Meghan's mother and best friends will be invited. The speaker notes the location is uncertain, but Los Angeles is a possibility. The speech pauses briefly, then a male speaker says "What?"

The audio clip begins with a calm, female voice discussing Prince Archie's upcoming birthday, mentioning he will receive gifts like his mother's favorite book, "The Giving Tree," and a rocking horse from Queen Elizabeth. The voice then transitions to the possibility of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle having a second child. All throughout the narration, a soft, gentle musical accompaniment plays, which seems to be background music.

The audio clip starts with a female speaker discussing Prince Harry and Meghan, mentioning their desire for two kids, and that they "might start trying in earnest pretty soon" to conceive. This segment has a news-report tone. Then a male speaker announces a new COVID-19 case in British Columbia. The tone here is informative and serious. Lastly, the first female speaker resumes, suggesting the pandemic has given the Sussexes time to bond and decide if they want another child. The tone returns to a news-reporting style.

The audio clip starts with a female speaker stating that "Meghan Markle is down to earth when no one is watching," followed by background music playing which sounds like an upbeat, cheerful, whimsical tune with string instruments. The speaker mentions Meghan Markle's engagement with Prince Harry in 2017, bringing her personal flair to the British Royal Family, and that she had her own career and ambitions before meeting Prince Harry. The speaker's tone is calm and steady, and it appears to be some form of news narration or reporting. The music plays throughout the whole clip.

The audio clip begins with a female speaker stating that "Little Megan is reportedly well, wiped by the royals," and continues by summarizing her take on royal life and the public's reaction. The tone is informative and serious. The speaker notes the Sussexes' decision to resign as senior working members. Concluding with their current location in Los Angeles, eager to begin a new phase in their lives.

The audio begins with the start of a slow, melancholic instrumental track, evoking a somber mood. Then, a female voice begins to speak, noting Meghan's down-to-earth nature despite negative remarks, and summarizing her pre-royal life as an actress and activist, living well before royalty. She summarizes the sacrifices made, with royal experts deeming the duchess "too independent." The speaker proceeds to quote an insider from a news source in 2019, who comments on the limitation on Meghan's freedom of movement, and this quote closes out the audio clip.

The audio clip begins with a woman narrating in a relatively formal tone, describing Meghan Markle's desire for control over her life and contrasting it with Catherine, the Duchess of Cambridge. She quotes, "Meghan expects perfection" and emphasizes the idea that royal life isn't about the individual. The narration transitions to a different woman's voice with a more conversational and emotional tone, stating "what that does internally is probably really damaging." The first narrator returns, quoting Meghan, "It's not enough just to survive something right. That's not the point of life." There's reference to the documentary, "Harry and Meghan, An African Journey", as the Duchess revealed she tried to adopt the British stiff upper lip. Then the second woman repeats "what that does internally is probably really damaging."

The audio clip begins with a female speaker stating that "Meghan Markle is very down to earth." She continues, noting that despite how Meghan Markle has been received in the UK, the Duchess is well-liked elsewhere. The speaker emphasizes again that she is "reportedly very down to earth."

The audio clip begins with a woman speaking in an even tone, describing her experiences meeting "incredible, interesting, and inspirational people". She mentions her privilege to have spent time with the Duke and Duchess of Sussex. Continuing, she quotes a statement from the Duchess's former facialist, Sarah Chapman, saying their client relationship "quickly turned into a dear friendship," with the facialist welcomed "into their lives."

The audio clip begins with a female speaker expressing gratitude for being a small part of someone's journey, praising their passion and compassion, and acknowledging the private moments that others don't see. Her tone is appreciative and heartfelt. The audio clip ends there.

The audio clip begins with a female speaker stating "It looks like moving on was the right move for the Sussexes." She continues, briefly summarizing the day's news regarding Meghan and Prince Harry, thanking the listener, and encouraging them to engage with the video by liking, commenting, subscribing, and pressing the notification bell. A brief musical jingle, likely for an intro or transition, abruptly cuts off the speech. Finally, the clip concludes with the playing of a soulful instrumental piece featuring an acoustic guitar, drums, and keyboard.
